title: American History Radio Collection
paragraphs: GRH/OTRR synthetic American-history archive containing dramatizations, speeches, news, music, interviews, and documentary recordings. Historical subject dates are separated from recording/broadcast dates.

The stories often return to U.S. politics and presidency, Historical news broadcasting, War and military history, Science and technology history, Frontier and westward expansion, and Civil rights and race.
plain_text:
GRH/OTRR synthetic American-history archive containing dramatizations, speeches, news, music, interviews, and documentary recordings. Historical subject dates are separated from recording/broadcast dates.
